title: Add StepsView
description: Create StepsView.swift. Iterates Recipe.sections; for each section with a non-nil name, renders a section header in .headline style. For each .step content item, renders a numbered row showing RecipeStepCombiner.combine(step:recipe:). Step numbering starts at 1 and restarts at 1 in each named section; the implicit unnamed leading section also starts at 1. For each .text content item, renders the raw string without a number prefix. Empty state shows 'No steps listed' when no step items exist in any section.
acceptance_criteria: Named sections render a .headline section header.
Steps are numbered starting from 1 and restart at 1 in each named section.
Section .text content items render without a number prefix.
Step text is produced by RecipeStepCombiner.combine(step:recipe:).
Empty state 'No steps listed' shown when no steps exist across all sections.

handoff_summary.completed: StepsView.swift created at CookbookApp/Recipes/StepsView.swift. The view takes a Recipe, checks for any .step content across all sections (empty state if none), then renders a SwiftUI List with one Section per recipe section. Named sections display a .headline header; step items are numbered sequentially starting at 1 per section; .text items render as secondary-tinted text without a number. Step text is produced by RecipeStepCombiner.combine(step:recipe:). Three previews cover multi-section, text-only, and empty states. xcodebuild confirms BUILD SUCCEEDED.

handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a private RecipeSectionStepsView helper to keep section-level row computation (step numbering) isolated per section. StepRowKind enum avoids stringly-typed branching. CookbookCore.Section qualified explicitly to prevent ambiguity with SwiftUI.Section in @ViewBuilder closures.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Three #Preview blocks cover: multi-section recipe with text interleaved, text-only section (no steps → empty state), and a fully empty Recipe.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Step numbering counts only .step items; .text items are skipped from the counter as specified.
